files.name: Name
queue.title: Queue
github.signed_out.title: Connect {name} to GitHub
github.signed_out.body: See issues and pull requests, comment, close them, and deploy commits to your server. {name} never sees your password.
github.signed_out.footer: Without GitHub, the Files tab works as a normal SFTP client.
github.no_access.app: No access to {repo}. Signing in with the browser authorizes the app, but it also has to be installed on the account that owns the repository ({owner}), for all repositories or this one. If {owner} is not your account, its owner installs it.
github.no_access.fine-grained: No access to {repo}. The token does not include this repository, or lacks the Issues and Pull requests permissions. Edit the token on GitHub (no need to paste it again). Fine-grained tokens only cover repositories of one owner; for a repository of another account you collaborate on, use a classic token with the repo scope.
github.no_access.classic: No access to {repo}. The token needs the repo scope, and your account needs access to the repository.
github.no_access.other: No access to {repo}. Sign in again with an account that can read it.
github.not_mergeable: GitHub cannot merge this pull request automatically (conflicts or required checks).
github.merge_confirm: Merge pull request #{number} ({head} into {base}) on GitHub?
github.not_on_github: The remote of this branch is not on github.com.
github.no_changes_body: Nothing to commit. Edit files in the repository and they show up here.
github.badge.head: local HEAD
github.ahead_of_server: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} ahead of server
github.files_changed: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} changed
github.diff.empty: No changes in this file's content.
github.diff.truncated: The diff is too long; only the first lines are shown.
github.no_repo.title: No repository yet
github.no_repo.body: Add a local git repository, or set a local folder that is a repository on a site in the Site Manager.
github.device.title: Sign in to GitHub
github.device.install: One more step on GitHub: install the app on the accounts whose repositories you use (all repositories or selected ones). Without it, issues and pull requests stay hidden.
github.token.title: Sign in with a token
github.token.body: Create a fine-grained personal access token for the repositories you deploy, then paste it here. It is kept in the system credential store.
github.token.permissions: Repository permissions: Contents (read and write), Issues (read and write), Pull requests (read and write), Metadata (read).
github.token.label: Personal access token
github.token.rejected: GitHub did not accept the token: {reason}
time.days_ago: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
sync.choose.title: Sync {server}
sync.choose.deploy_body: Upload the committed version of the repository to the server. You see the commits and files first and can skip any file.
sync.choose.pull_body: Take files changed or added on the server into the local repository folder. They show up in Changes, where you review, commit and push them.
sync.preview.pull_body: These server files differ from the local folder. Ticked files are copied into it; nothing is committed or pushed.
sync.preview.commits: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} not on the server yet
sync.preview.marker_only: No files ticked: only the marker is updated to this commit. Use this when the server already has these files (uploaded by hand).
sync.preview.nothing_deploy: No files to upload; the marker is updated to the current commit.
sync.preview.nothing_pull: The server has nothing that differs from the local folder.
sync.backup_first: Back up the server before syncing
sync.edited_on_server: {count, plural, one {# file edited on server} other {# files edited on server}}
sync.marker.title: Track sync state on {server}?
sync.progress.title: Syncing with {server}
prefs.title: Preferences
changes.discard_body: Edited and deleted files get their last committed version back; new files go to the Recycle Bin.
empty.first.title: Connect your first server
empty.first.text: Save it as a site to keep its password, folders and sync settings, or type an address in the bar above for a quick connection.
empty.offline.title: Not connected
empty.pick_file: Select a file to see what changed
empty.pick_issue: Select one on the left to read it
files.not_connected_hint: Connect to a server to see its files.
files.error.timeout: the server did not respond in time
files.error.desktop_only: Local files are only available in the desktop app.
resume.title: Unfinished transfers
resume.body: {count, plural, one {# transfer to {server} did not finish last time.} other {# transfers to {server} did not finish last time.}} Continue?
resume.failed: {count, plural, one {# of them had failed.} other {# of them had failed.}}
dialog.hostkey.title: Unknown host key
dialog.hostkey.body: The server {host}:{port} sent a host key this computer has not seen before. Check that its fingerprint matches the one your hosting provider shows.
dialog.password.title: Password required
dialog.keyfile.title: Key passphrase required
dialog.interactive.title: Server asks for login details
dialog.exists.title: File already exists
dialog.unsupported.title: Not supported yet
dialog.unsupported.body: The server asked for something this version cannot answer yet ({type}). It will be declined.
files.browse_hint: Choose a folder in the system dialog
topbar.no_recent: Servers you connect to appear here.
files.connect.remember_hint: Keep the password in the system credential store (never in plain text)
files.error.remember: Connected, but the password could not be saved: {reason}
dialog.cert.title: Unknown certificate
dialog.cert.body: The server {host}:{port} presented a TLS certificate that this computer does not trust.
dialog.cert.mismatch: The certificate was not issued for this host name.
dialog.cert.not_yet_valid: The certificate is not valid yet.
dialog.cert.subject: Issued to
dialog.insecure.title: Unencrypted connection
dialog.insecure.body: The server {host}:{port} does not support FTP over TLS.
dialog.insecure.warning: Your password and files will be sent in plain text and can be read on the way.
dialog.resumption.title: TLS session resumption not supported
dialog.resumption.body: The server {host}:{port} does not resume the TLS session for file transfers, so they are less protected against tampering. Allow transfers anyway?
dialog.exists.apply_all: Do the same for all files in the queue
fileop.rename.title: Rename
files.sync_browse_hint: Synchronized browsing (Ctrl+Y): opening a folder on one side opens the same folder on the other, inside the site's local and server folders
files.drag_out_folders: Server folders and files over 200 MB cannot be dragged out of the window yet; download them first.
files.drag_out_wait: Still downloading the files for dragging out; drag them again in a moment.
fileop.mkfile.title: New file
fileop.mkdir.title: New folder
fileop.delete.title: Delete
fileop.delete.remote: {count, plural, one {Delete # item from the server? This cannot be undone.} other {Delete # items from the server? This cannot be undone.}}
fileop.delete.local: {count, plural, one {Move # item to the Recycle Bin (trash)?} other {Move # items to the Recycle Bin (trash)?}}
dialog.hostkey.changed: The host key of {host}:{port} has changed since you last trusted it. Someone may be intercepting the connection, or the server was reinstalled. Connect only if you know why it changed.
dialog.hostkey.remember: Always trust this key for this server
dialog.cert.changed: The certificate of {host}:{port} is not the one you trusted before. Connect only if you know why it changed.
dialog.cert.remember: Always trust this certificate for this server
sites.title: Site Manager
sites.pick: Select a site or create one.
sites.name: Name
sites.sync_paths_all: None ticked: every folder of the repository is synced and scanned. Tick folders to limit sync (and the server scan) to them.
sites.sync_paths_some: {count, plural, one {Only the ticked folder is synced and scanned.} other {Only the # ticked folders are synced and scanned.}}
sites.sync_paths_no_repo: Set a local folder that is a git repository with commits to choose folders.
prefs.later.logging: The message log arrives in a later update.
shared.title: This server is open in another window
shared.body: Each window has its own connections, so the server now gets the requests of both. Hosts that limit requests may block you for a while.
shared.tip: To move several folders, queue them in one window: its transfers share one set of connections.
prefs.discord: Show what I'm doing in Discord (Rich Presence)
prefs.discord_hint: Discord shows "Moving files", "Syncing a server" and the like on your profile. Never server addresses or site names.
prefs.discord_repo: Include the repository's name (public GitHub repositories only)
discord.queue: {count, plural, one {# file in the queue} other {# files in the queue}}
prefs.snap_layouts: Show snap layouts when the mouse rests on the maximize button (Windows 11)
prefs.warn_shared: Warn when another window is connected to the same server
twins.title: Highlight matching folders?
twins.body: Some folders exist on both sides, like "{name}". They can be tinted grey, so you can see where your computer and the server match.
twins.browse: Also turn on synchronized browsing (Ctrl+Y): opening a folder on one side opens it on the other
twins.later: Asked only once. Change it any time in Preferences → File lists.
prefs.mark_twins: Grey out folders that exist on both sides
prefs.forward_slashes: Use / in local paths too (paste paths between the panes)
prefs.no_trusted: No host keys or certificates are remembered yet.
prefs.temp_upload: Upload to a temporary name first
prefs.signed_out: Not signed in. Changes and History work without GitHub; issues, pull requests and pushing to GitHub need an account.
prefs.token_storage: The token is kept in the system credential store, never in a file.
prefs.repos_hint: Sites with a local folder that is a git repository are listed automatically; add others in the GitHub tab.
prefs.close_issues: After a sync, comment on and close the issues the deployed commits fix ("Fixes #12")
prefs.check_updates: Look for updates at start and once a day
update.title: Updates
update.up_to_date: You have the newest version of {name}.
update.restart_note: The app restarts after the update. Transfers in progress are stopped.
prefs.updates_source: Updates come from the GitHub releases of this project. Nothing is sent except the version number.
edit.saved.title: File changed
edit.saved.body: {name} was saved in the editor. Upload it to the server?
edit.saved.dont_ask: Upload this file without asking from now on
sync.scan_edits_hint: Walk every synced folder on the server to find files changed by hand since the last sync
sync.state.behind: {count, plural, one {# commit to deploy} other {# commits to deploy}}
sync.state.unknown_commit: Synced from a commit you do not have
sync.uncommitted: {count, plural, one {# uncommitted change} other {# uncommitted changes}}
sync.uncommitted_hint: Not deployed until committed (GitHub tab → Changes):
sync.marker.body: {name} can keep one small file, {path} (about 300 bytes), on this server. It records which commit was last deployed, so you and your teammates can tell when the server is out of date. Your files are not touched.
sync.marker.remember: Remember my choice for this server
sync.differ.body: The server does not match your local repository. Syncing will overwrite files on the server.
sync.differ.removed: {count, plural, other {# removed from the repository (kept on the server)}}
backups.title: Backups of {server}
backups.keep: {count, plural, one {The newest backup is kept.} other {The newest # backups are kept.}} Each holds the files a sync overwrote.
backups.empty: No backups yet. Syncing with "Back up the server" creates one.
backups.now_body: Copies the synced folders of {root} from the server to this computer, as they are now.
backups.restore_body: {count, plural, one {Upload # file back to {root}, overwriting the server copy?} other {Upload # files back to {root}, overwriting the server copies?}}
backups.delete_body: Delete this backup from this computer? This cannot be undone.
prefs.scan_edits: Scan the whole server for hand edits on connect and Check (slow on big servers; a sync always checks the files it overwrites)
prefs.sync_preview: Show the commits and files before every sync (otherwise only when versions differ)
prefs.ask_someone_else: The server was synced by someone else
prefs.ask_local_only: There are only local changes (normal update)
queue.skipped_hint: Not transferred: the "file exists" answer kept the existing file
queue.scanning: {count, plural, one {Scanning folders... # file found} other {Scanning folders... # files found}}
sites.pace_hint: For hosts that refuse connections with "too many requests". Each command and transfer waits this long after the previous one.
dialog.insecure.remember: Do not ask again for this server
github.new_issue.title: New issue in {repo}
github.new_issue.name: Title
files.reconnect_failed: Connection lost and could not be restored. Connect again when the server is back.
ui.resize: Drag to resize, double-click to reset
menu.label: Menu
about.body: {name} is an SFTP and FTP client with a GitHub tab and safe, version-aware server sync, built on the FileZilla engine.
about.licenses: Free software under the GNU General Public License v3 or later. Includes the FileZilla engine (GPL), libfilezilla and fzssh (AGPL), the Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts (SIL Open Font License) and Lucide icons (ISC).
prefs.keys.enter: Open the folder or transfer the selected files
prefs.keys.delete: Delete (local files go to the Recycle Bin)
prefs.keys.select: Select a range / add to the selection
prefs.keys.move: Move instead of copy while dragging between panes
prefs.unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
prefs.unsaved.body: Save the changed preferences before closing?
labels.title: {count, plural, one {Color label for # folder} other {Color label for # folders}}
labels.hint: Labels are kept on this computer only.
editor.heading: Heading
log.title: Log
prefs.simultaneous_hint: Each extra transfer opens another connection to the server while a batch runs. Sites with a pause between requests (Site Manager → Transfer) always use one.
prefs.auto_reconnect: Reconnect automatically when the server drops the connection (3 tries)
